note: Each mob's art rules (world/mobs.ts, and the bot's web/town-mobs.ts; its art is manifest mobs.<id>; how mobs live, aggro, reach, attack pace, leash, respawn: classes/stats.json mobBehaviour). Frames are 0-based (the art READMEs count some from 1; these win). attackFrame = the attack anim's frame where the hit lands; charge = the Tire Roller's lunge frames (first, last); shadow = [w, h] art px of the ground shadow, centred on the anchor; floats = the sprite hangs above its anchor (the shadow stays on the ground there); variants = the looks, one picked per spawn (keep in step with manifest mobs.<id>.variants). pack = a pack's size (lowest, highest: a seeded count, each its own mob round a leader); roll = the Tire Roller's idle roll now and then (chance after a rest, tiles straight along its facing, tiles a second); drift = it drifts (its pace in tiles a second, its rests in ms: short, so it keeps floating); slowMs = its attack slows the player hit (shown only); shell = hits from a player in its front quarter are blocked; eye = where its zap leaves (art px in the SE cell; mirrored for SW and NW). The golem: attackFrame = Tire Slam, tossFrame = Scrap Toss's release, glareFrames = the Lamp Glare cone's first and last frame; radius = its body's radius in tiles (reach to it is measured to that edge); top = the art's highest pixel row in its cells (its HP bar, name and numbers go there, not at the cell's top); lamp = its lamp per facing (art px in that facing's cell: enrage, glare and the lamp burst start there); slamFist = the ground under its fist as the Tire Slam lands (the impact); tossFist = its raised fist on the Scrap Toss's release (the scrap leaves there). Measured from the art.
